metadata.description: Required. Agent name (lowercase, no spaces).
Required. Resource group that holds the agent + its identity + LAW + App Insights. Separate from the RGs the agent monitors.
Required. Region. Only the regions in @allowed are currently supported by the SRE Agent RP.
Required. Resource groups the agent is granted access to (read or act, depending on accessLevel).
Optional. Low = read-only investigation. High = can take actions on target RGs.
Optional. Review = human approval before actions. Automatic = agent acts independently.
Optional. Upgrade channel for the agent runtime.
Optional. Monthly agent unit consumption limit.
Optional. Default LLM provider (MicrosoftFoundry, Anthropic).
Optional. Default LLM model name.
Optional. Azure resource tags applied to the agent.
Optional. Resource ID of an existing UAMI. If provided, skips creating a new one.
Optional. Skip all role assignments. Use on redeploy or when RBAC is pre-configured to avoid RoleAssignmentExists errors.
Optional. Resource ID of an existing Application Insights for agent telemetry. If provided, skips creating a new one.
Optional. Full ARM resource ID of a delegated subnet for VNet integration.
Optional. Sandbox egress mode: Unrestricted (default), Limited, or AzureVNet.
Optional. Additional hosts the sandbox may reach.
Optional. Registry catalog IDs (pypi, npmjs, nuget-org) to allow.
Optional. Code-repo providers (Github, AzureDevOps) to allow.
Optional. Allow remote HTTP MCP server endpoints in sandbox egress.
Optional. Use VNet private DNS resolver. Only for AzureVNet mode.
Optional. Enable an Application Insights connector. Requires appInsightsResourceId + appInsightsAppId.
Conditional. Required when enableAppInsightsConnector=true. Full Azure resource ID of the App Insights component.
Conditional. Required when enableAppInsightsConnector=true. App Insights Application ID (GUID from the Overview blade).
Optional. Enable a Log Analytics connector. Requires lawResourceId.
Conditional. Required when enableLogAnalyticsConnector=true. Full Azure resource ID of the LAW workspace.
Optional. Enable an Azure Monitor connector that reads alerts at the subscription level.
Optional. Lookback window in days for the Azure Monitor connector.
Optional. Enable a daily 8am health summary scheduled task.
Optional. Enable a PreToolUse hook that denies delete_*/remove_* tools when the target name contains "prod"/"prd".
Optional. Enable a "safety-rules" common prompt (no restarts without paging on-call, confirm subscription before destructive ops).

Optional. Deploy a Logic App that acts as an auth bridge for external webhooks (Dynatrace, Grafana, etc.) that cannot natively acquire Azure AD tokens. Set to true when using httpTriggers with external webhook sources.
Conditional. Required when enableWebhookBridge=true. The SRE Agent HTTP Trigger URL that the Logic App should forward requests to. Obtained from the httpTriggers creation step.
Optional. Subagent definitions (array). Shape: see parameters.reference.json.
Optional. Tool definitions (KustoTool / HttpClientTool / PythonFunctionTool / LinkTool).
Optional. Skill definitions (Markdown playbooks bound to tools).
Optional. Scheduled task definitions (cron-triggered runs).
Optional. Incident filter definitions (AzMonitor / PagerDuty / ServiceNow rules + handling subagent).
Optional. Connector definitions for any kind not covered by toggles above (kusto, mcp, github, azuredevops, teams, outlook, servicenow, pagerduty, grafana) or to override a toggle-generated entry.
Optional. Hook definitions for any handler beyond the toggles above (additional PreToolUse/Start/Stop entries).
Optional. Common prompt definitions for any prompt beyond the toggles above.
Optional. Plugin configuration definitions. Plugin installations themselves are wired via apply-extras.sh.
Optional. Resource ID of an existing User-Assigned Managed Identity. If provided, skips creating a new one.
Optional. Resource ID of an existing Application Insights for agent telemetry. If provided, skips creating a new one.
Optional. Skip all role assignments. Set to true when RBAC is pre-configured or on redeploy to avoid RoleAssignmentExists errors.
Optional. Full ARM resource ID of a delegated subnet (Microsoft.App/environments) for VNet integration. Leave empty for no VNet.
Optional. Sandbox egress mode: Unrestricted (default), Limited, or AzureVNet.
Optional. Additional hosts the sandbox may reach (e.g. *.contoso.com). Only used in Limited/AzureVNet modes.
Optional. Registry catalog IDs (pypi, npmjs, nuget-org) whose hosts are allowed. Only used in Limited/AzureVNet modes.
Optional. Code-repo providers (Github, AzureDevOps) whose hosts are allowed. Only used in Limited/AzureVNet modes.
Optional. Allow remote HTTP MCP server endpoints in sandbox egress.
Optional. Use VNet private DNS resolver instead of platform default. Only for AzureVNet mode.
